s01.h1: The Connected Sales Environment for Off-Plan Real Estate
s01.subheadingBodyCopy: A platform built for REGA and Wafi off-plan workflows that takes buyers from masterplan to Nafath verification and a generated SPA, with no paper handoffs.
specStrip: Built for REGA and Wafi off-plan workflows

s02.h2: Turn Off-Plan Browsing into Digital Reservations
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: Off-plan buyers drop out between static brochures and paper handoffs. The CSE connects 3D exploration, live inventory and digital reservation in one continuous flow.
s02.block01Body: Buyers move from the community masterplan into unit-level tours, checking local infrastructure, sunlight and the actual balcony view before they open the floor plan.
s02.block02Body: Shows live unit availability synced with your CRM and ERP, alongside interactive floor plans and milestone payment calculators. Buyers adjust the down payment and construction-linked schedule to fit their budget.
s02.block03Body: Buyers verify their identity through Nafath, the platform generates the Sales and Purchase Agreement (SPA), and a timed unit hold linked to the project's Wafi escrow process reserves the unit, all without paper handoffs.
block03Features: Linked to the project's Wafi escrow process

s03.h2: Replace Agent Notes with Measured Buyer Intent
s03.subheadingBodyCopy: Off-plan sales still run on agent notes and website pageviews. The CSE records every buyer interaction, so sales leaders can see who is ready to buy and why.
s03.card01Body: Measures second-by-second dwell time on each unit type, corner layout and view orientation, so you can see which features draw serious interest.
s03.card02Body: Shows how buyers adjust down-payment sliders and milestone schedules, so your team has an indicated budget range before the first call.
s03.card03Body: Pinpoints where buyers drop off, from masterplan exploration to Nafath verification and SPA generation, so your team follows up with deal-ready buyers first.

s04.h2: Static Showroom Sales vs. Connected Sales Environment
s04.subheadingBodyCopy: How the CSE replaces manual off-plan sales steps with one connected, measurable workflow.
row1: Printed brochures and static PDF floor plans
3D masterplan navigation and unit virtual tours
row2: Spreadsheets reconciled by hand, with frequent double-bookings
Sub-500 ms inventory sync with timed unit holds
row4: In-person ID scans and paper photocopies
row5: Days of manual SPA drafting, couriers and wet signatures
row6: Dwell time, financing and drop-off telemetry

s05.q5: How does Nafath verification work in the CSE?
s05.a5: Before placing a timed unit hold, buyers confirm their identity through Nafath, the national single sign-on.
